ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central interior (approx. 65%), while low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edges, distal tips, and notch region (approx. 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the medial sections of both lobes. These regions are bordered by low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and the median notch. Extensive stippled mottling is present at the transition zones between high and low intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured angle of approximately 105 degrees; depth is pronounced, extending into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are detected along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant structural irregularity (high-amplitude peaks/valleys) is present at both distal tips due to external biological clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch, flattening out towards the distal tips. The overall contour is symmetrical.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are concentrated at the leftmost and rightmost distal tips. Isolated white circular spots are scattered on the low-intensity black field of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, curved low-intensity (dark) linear mark is visible on the high-intensity (white) surface of the right lobe, oriented vertically near the mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable vertical curved scar on the right lobe; heavy crustose-like pixel clusters at both distal tips indicating significant external colonization.
